text:
Dana (Growth): quick ping  weekly KPIs: launch-post engagement steady but paid MQLs and webinar signups from paid slipped ~19% WoW. dropping a quick triage here before Friday email. :eyes:
Eshan (Analytics): looking now. early signal: spike in conversions with blank utm_campaign and a concurrent bounce uptick around 14:05 PT for a subset of paid clicks.
Maya (MarOps): I updated campaign canonicalization earlier this sprint but only for partner feeds; paid tags untouched.
Leo (Product Marketing): only an organic headline micro-test yesterday. paid creative asset IDs unchanged.
Eshan (Analytics): ran quick debug query to see campaign distribution:
```
SELECT COALESCE(utm_campaign,'(null)') AS campaign, COUNT(*) AS convs
FROM marketing_leads
WHERE created_at >= '2026-09-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY convs DESC
LIMIT 12;
```
Eshan (Analytics): result shows a bump in (null) for referer host fast-redirects.example and that vendor posted a redirect shim change to status page this morning.
Maya (MarOps): that matches my thread with FastRedirects (FR-508). they're A/B testing a new click handler. I'll ask them to pause for prod traffic.
Dana (Growth): for the Friday KPI email we need defensible numbers. Can BI add a pragmatic fallback attribution column so leadership sees corrected paid counts? even a simple referer->campaign map or session-last-touch heuristic is fine.
Eshan (Analytics): I can add heuristic_campaign in ETL: utm_campaign -> session last-non-null -> referer-domain mapping. Low risk. ETA ~40m to land in BI.
viz-bot: dashboard "launch_kpis_weekly" updated by Eshan. https://bi.redwood/d/launch_kpis_weekly
Dana (Growth): perfect. once that's live I'll re-run the WoW and update the KPI email with a short caveat: "Attribution adjustment in progress; numbers may shift."
Leo (Product Marketing): long-term suggestion: server-side hidden campaign token on registration so we don't rely on client querystrings. low lift and prevents this class of problem.
Maya (MarOps): adding hidden_campaign_server to backlog and escalating FR-508.
Eshan (Analytics): will post interim numbers (raw vs heuristic) when ETL finishes so we can show delta in the email.
Dana (Growth): owners: Maya -> vendor escalation + backlog; Eshan -> ETL heuristic + dashboard patch; Leo -> confirm paid creative stable; Dana -> re-run and finalize Friday KPI email. Thanks team :thumbsup:
